procedural_matters: Case presented by Alexander Bratt The international jury was properly constituted under appendix N. Protest was filed after end of protest time limit. The information was received after the end of protest time limit, then we had to get the list of coaches and then as soon as possible the protest was lodged. The International Jury finds good reason to extend the time limit.
facts: After races were done on Thursday, 31st of July, boats were being towed back to shore.
Support person Linda Taddei (LT) was towing 5 ITA boats.
LT was coming up on the slipway at high speed, the rib and all feva’s were planing.
100 meters from the shore LT slowed down.
GBR 7355 was sailing back to shore on her own and was nearly at the slipway.
LT and a Dutch coach boat towing NED boats arrived at the same time at the slipway.
LT positioned her rib with the towed boats between the slipway and GBR 7355, cutting GBR 7355 off from the slipway.
The third boat in the tow ended up being less than a boat length from GBR 7355.
GBR 7355 passed between two of the ITA boats still in the tow and reached the slipway before any ITA or NED boats.
After the crossing, the ITA boats GBR 7355 passed between made contact, the bow of the boat astern touched the stern of the boat ahead.
There was no damage to any boats.
